title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Rare-Book Glass Case. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Rare-Book Glass Case
options.lineage: museum rare-book vitrine under cool gallery light
options.thesis: Your library lives behind lit glass: translucent panes, labeled specimens, indigo depth — not generic glassmorphism chrome.
options.viewport: Home opens as a lit case: four glass instrument tiles for library vitals, then a glass shelf of recently added labeled books; primary Add sits as a Material FAB.
options.risk: Can collapse into generic purple glass UI if panes, labels, and gallery light are not literal.

raised.raise: Stock status is a signal lamp: green / amber / red only, never decorative accents.
Every book specimen carries an equal-clarity printed label: name, category, quantity.
Saturated color lives only at status fringes; the case body stays cool indigo glass.

options.label: Call-Number Spine Wall
options.lineage: library spine labels and class color bands
options.thesis: Inventory as a wall of call-number spines: category bands, quantity as shelf depth, find-by-scan.
options.viewport: Home as a cropped shelf: category color bands as columns, recent titles as spines; Books screen is the full spine wall with search as the finding rod.
options.risk: Also the direction most book-inventory runs land on — familiar and effective.

options.label: Miura Inventory Packet
options.thesis: Categories fold into a gold packet; one pull deploys the full crease-grid of your collection.
options.viewport: Home starts as a compact packet of totals; pull deploys parallelogram cells for each category and recent books along the crease grid.
options.case: Strong audience ID with paper/books; loses on Operate clarity versus a glass-case dashboard of vitals.
options.risk: Fold metaphor can obscure Material CRUD affordances if overplayed.

options.label: Datamatics Stock Field
options.thesis: Quantity as pure barcode density: black/white stock columns you scan and invert.
options.viewport: Home is a barcode field of copy counts; selecting a column focuses one title’s numbers while the field dims.
options.case: Wins product clarity for quantity-first inventory; loses audience ID for a personal digital library.
options.risk: Feels like a monitoring tool, not a library you care for.

options.label: Night Library Six-Pack
options.thesis: Library vitals as six luminous gauges you cross-check before acting.
options.viewport: Home is two rows of three gauges: books, copies, categories, low stock, recent rate, attention; Books is the flight log.
options.case: Holds Operate clarity for the dashboard; loses audience ID for book collectors vs pilots.
options.risk: Aviation costume can outrank the book subject if dials dominate.

options.label: Man-Machine Signal Grid
options.thesis: Neon traffic-grid wiring for every library node.
options.case: Loses both audience ID and library clarity for personal book inventory.
options.kept: Signal-lamp status vocabulary (green / amber / red) transferred into the glass case.
options.viewport: Grid of wired nodes for each book.
options.risk: Reads as synth-band merch, not a library.

options.label: Busy Library Cutaway
options.thesis: Every shelf loses its wall; every book wears a printed label.
options.case: Loses both axes for an adult offline inventory Operate surface.
options.kept: Equal-clarity specimen labels on every book card.
options.risk: Children’s-book energy fights Material inventory trust.

options.label: Iridescent Case Edge
options.thesis: Pastel spectral fringe on an otherwise quiet glass body.
options.case: Loses audience ID and stock-task clarity.
options.kept: Saturated color only at status fringes; case body stays cool.
options.viewport: Quiet field with spectral edge accents.

canonCard.label: Glass Material library CRUD
canonCard.thesis: What book-inventory apps ship: soft indigo-purple glass cards, bottom nav, FAB, Material forms — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Dashboard metric cards, book list with glass tiles, FAB add.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the category AI default by design.
